review_description: I took note of your warnings and advices from your web sites to select a system that was able to respond to shade and variable conditions -  I received seven quotes which provided different systems with similar pricing - the range of prices varied by less than $500 and I did not need performance for snow loadings but rather high temperatures and possible hail impact effects for continued life performance of the panels under Australian conditionsI was also keen to stay away from high voltages and a string system where I would have lost performance by variable shading across the panels - I have accepted the use of paired microinverters to optimise the individual panel output so that for 16 panels there are 8 microinverters located on the underside of the panels being shielded from the sun but still with adequate ventilation to improve the overall life span performance  .The system I have elected to use has also sought to maximise the sun loading by locating tilted panels facing to both the East and the West.  The system is not visible to the street frontage so there is not a statement advertising the installationI am now seeking to get real time indication of the performance of the panels for the amount of power being delivered to the GRID such that I can time my usage to when there is a significant flow to the grid and not pay grid charges for what is being used â€“ i.e., I could time the AC usage or the washing machine/oven etc  to when there is solar power being generated that is adequate to be able to run these appliances without grid charges â€“ if I can gain real â€œflowâ€ information then I might consider adding this to the installation â€“ but none of the available electronics found thus far with a track history gives this as an option â€“ I am still searching and remain optimistic that this will be found - I will then be able to read off a panel inside the house and know whether it is the right time to use my electrical equipment inside the house
From time of agreeing to go ahead we've had a two month wait until installation. Due to be installed the 26th August.

They  came  out  to  check   roof,  +  meter  box .    Then  gave  me  Quote,  which  is  not  the  cheapest,  but  I  went  them.Then  they   did  the installation  +  connect  electrical  grid.  Their  workmanship  was  neat  and  tidy.
It was only installed today; the meter goes in next week and I suppose it gets switched on soon after. I'll be in a better position to answer questions after I get my next power bill.
